We have a critical bug in our shipping cost calculator — it's undercharging customers on fractional weights and completely ignoring the international surcharge. The file is at `logistics/src/utils/shipping.py` and there are already test cases written at `logistics/tests/unit/test_shipping.py` that expose the failures.

Our finance team is demanding a full audit trail before this goes to production. I need you to fix the bug AND produce the formal documentation artifacts required by our internal delivery standard — specifically a signed-off contract before you touch any code, a documented proof that the tests were failing *before* your fix and passing *after*, and a complete handoff summary for the reviewer that includes what changed, which files were touched, how it was validated, and how to roll back if needed.

Please produce the code fix and all required documentation artifacts.
